settings.title: What we stand on
settings.pillar_body_1: Black Masking Indians, second lines, social aid and pleasure clubs — the traditions that raised us decide what we make, not the trend cycle.
settings.pillar_body_2: Heavyweight fabric, chain-stitched crests, puff-print done slow. Every piece is built to outlast the season it dropped in.
settings.pillar_body_3: The city runs on its night economy — the musicians, cooks, and bartenders who keep the lights humming. This is their uniform.
